mapper.sql: eao.id AS exercise_activity_option_id, eao.activity_name_ko, eao.major_heading AS option_major_heading, eao.low_physical_activity_id, eao.low_met_value, eao.low_source_description, eao.low_met_source, eao.medium_physical_activity_id, eao.medium_met_value, eao.medium_source_description, eao.medium_met_source, eao.high_physical_activity_id, eao.high_met_value, eao.high_source_description, eao.high_met_source
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM exercise_activity_options eao
eao.activity_name_ko ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR eao.low_source_description ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR eao.medium_source_description ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR eao.high_source_description ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR eao.major_heading ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY eao.activity_name_ko
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO physical_activities ( compendium_code, compendium_version, major_heading, met_value, description ) VALUES ( #{compendiumCode}, #{compendiumVersion}, #{majorHeading}, #{metValue}, #{description} ) ON CONFLICT (compendium_code) DO UPDATE SET compendium_version = EXCLUDED.compendium_version, major_heading = EXCLUDED.major_heading, met_value = EXCLUDED.met_value, description = EXCLUDED.description
mapper.select:
WITH inserted AS ( INSERT INTO exercise_records ( user_id, exercise_activity_option_id, intensity_level, exercise_date, duration_minutes, calories_burned, memo, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{exerciseActivityOptionId}, #{intensityLevel}, #{exerciseDate}, #{durationMinutes}, #{caloriesBurned}, #{memo}, NOW(), NOW() ) RETURNING id, user_id, exercise_activity_option_id, intensity_level, exercise_date, duration_minutes, calories_burned, memo, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT er.id, er.user_id, er.intensity_level, er.exercise_date, er.duration_minutes, er.calories_burned, er.memo, er.created_at, er.updated_at,
FROM inserted er JOIN exercise_activity_options eao ON eao.id = er.exercise_activity_option_id

SELECT er.id, er.user_id, er.intensity_level, er.exercise_date, er.duration_minutes, er.calories_burned, er.memo, er.created_at, er.updated_at,
FROM exercise_records er JOIN exercise_activity_options eao ON eao.id = er.exercise_activity_option_id WHERE er.user_id = #{userId} AND er.exercise_date = #{exerciseDate} ORDER BY er.created_at, er.id
